sourcePolicy: Native-grid reconstruction; concept reference PNGs are not read by the builder.
comparisonContract: All candidates use identical frame dimensions, pivots, art-local preview geometry, derived simulation geometry, truth-scene placements, and crowded-scene repetitions.

measuredVisibleExtents.description: Per-candidate opaque x/y bounds, width, height, and pixel count measured from generated native art.

candidates.name: Gilded Ossuary
candidates.explanation: Carved bone, worn stone, and restrained gold make the crypt feel ancient and severe. Cyan player accents and amber attacks lift the important action above the dark floor.

tradeoff.readability: Strong silhouettes and bright gameplay accents; the stone detail needs disciplined restraint.
tradeoff.productionCost: Highest of the three because armor, bone, and trim need careful clusters.

constructionRules.outline: narrow 1-pixel near-black contour with gold joint accents
constructionRules.shapeGrammar: tall plated reliquaries, narrow bone blades, angular gold fittings

candidates.name: Moonlit Tapestry
candidates.explanation: Soft indigo stone, pale masks, and woven lavender marks make the arena feel like a haunted storybook. Coral attacks and icy pickups stay distinct without breaking the quiet nighttime mood.

tradeoff.readability: Calm value groups are easy on the eye; pale enemies need firm outlines in crowded scenes.
tradeoff.productionCost: Medium, with repeatable cloth, stone, and moon-mark patterns.

constructionRules.outline: soft indigo 1-pixel contour with pale cut-paper rims
constructionRules.shapeGrammar: asymmetric flowing capes, broad wings, crescents, petals, and tapered legs

candidates.name: Arcade Reliquary
candidates.explanation: Chunky shapes, deep navy gaps, and electric color make every object read like an arcade token. Magenta danger, cyan pickups, and an orange player jacket create the fastest visual scan of the three.

tradeoff.readability: Highest immediate contrast and the cleanest read at native size.
tradeoff.productionCost: Lowest, because broad clusters and compact ramps scale cleanly across the catalog.
tradeoff.mood: Fast, bold, and supernatural with an arcade edge.

constructionRules.outline: bold 2-pixel near-black contour and stepped neon corners
constructionRules.shapeGrammar: square cores, triangular wings and attacks, block limbs, minimal interior marks
